_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.53.1 (fixes: where: compares two columns with any operator; a join on a name given with `as` leads to the parent); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.73.0 (fuzzy canvas lists, rename an unnest, name unnested keys). beamlynx-ui 0.73.0 needs pine-lang 0.53 (its RequiredVersion).
